title: Evaluation and LLM-Guided Learning of ICD Coding Rationales
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the explainability of ICD coding models through metrics of faithfulness and plausibility. The term 'faithfulness' refers to a technical metric in explainable AI (XAI) regarding how well an explanation reflects a model's actual reasoning, not religious faith or spiritual traditions. No benchmarking or evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics is conducted.
